title: Warm Champorado
blurb: Filipino sweet cocoa rice porridge with a drizzle of evaporated milk.

steps.text: Combine cooked rice, cocoa, sugar and water in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave in 1-minute bursts, stirring each time, until thickened and the rice reaches 74°C throughout.
Let it thicken for a minute, then drizzle with evaporated milk.

tip: Start with fresh cooked rice or rice that was cooled quickly and refrigerated. This estimate uses cooked rice.

title: Sinangag at Itlog (Garlic Rice & Egg)
blurb: The classic leftover-rice fix — garlic fried rice topped with a fried or scrambled egg.

steps.text: Mince the garlic and separate any clumps of cold rice.
Sauté the garlic in oil over medium heat until fragrant and pale golden.
Toss the rice with the garlic and salt until the rice reaches 74°C throughout.
Fry the egg in the same skillet until its white and yolk are firm. Serve over the garlic rice.

Rest the egg briefly, then split it between the rolls and add the cheese.

title: Ginger Lugaw with Egg
blurb: Creamy Filipino ginger rice porridge with boiled egg and calamansi.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, slice the ginger, crush the garlic and chop the scallion.

Season with salt and serve with the sliced hard-boiled egg, scallion and calamansi.

title: Tortang Talong (Eggplant Omelet)

Fry in oil over medium heat, flipping once, until the egg is fully set and reaches 71°C.

title: Ginisang Munggo (Mung Bean Stew)
